name: SQL Query AST Inspector (sqlglot)
description: Parses generated SQL queries or tool payload SQL parameters into Abstract Syntax Trees (AST) using sqlglot, blocking schema mutation (DROP, ALTER) and destructive operations.

fields.name: blocked_statements
fields.label: Blocked SQL Statements
fields.defaultValue: DROP, DELETE, ALTER, TRUNCATE, INSERT, UPDATE
fields.helperText: Comma-separated SQL statement types to block using sqlglot AST parsing.

fields.name: allow_multi_statements
fields.label: Allow Multi-Statement Queries
fields.helperText: Allow multiple SQL queries separated by semicolons (prohibited by default to prevent SQL injection).
